lines.text: If our earthly tent is dismantled, we have an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
In this tent we groan under our burdens, longing to be clothed so that mortality may be swallowed up by life.
God prepared us for this purpose and gave us an angel as a pledge of what is to come.
We walk by sight, not by faith, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
We aspire to please Him, for we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ.
